reviews.reviewNote: Published on the project owner's decision, 3 August 2026, against a reviewer recommendation to stop it as an internal exploration. The disagreement was narrow and is recorded here rather than settled silently: the concept cannot show what the shop sells, so on the fifth check's "is this better than what they already have" the live gallery wins on photography. The owner's position — that the drawn tiles are visibly labelled placeholders, that the rest of the loop carries enough value to be read on its own, and that asking an owner to imagine their own imagery in place of a labelled placeholder is a small ask — is consistent with Betty's Better Butters and Douglas & Cromie, both public on the same basis. Reviewed against the live shop at phone and desktop; the 27 July finding that the live collection pages already carry price, artist, product-type and stock filters still holds and the concept states it on the page.
